title: Closeout summary: Add declaredCommand and expectedObservable to RequiredCloseoutGate schema
body:

## Outcome

WHY: the gate record (packages/core/src/records.ts lines 102-116) has no way to carry the filer-declared done condition; gates only constrain evidence kind, outcome and count. WHAT: additive schema change - optional declaredCommand (exact command string the executor must run and record) and expectedObservable (substring or anchored regex the satisfying evidence summary or linked artifact must contain; pick one matching semantic and document it, preferring substring for determinism and injection-safety) on RequiredCloseoutGate, threaded through createRequiredCloseoutGates (packages/work-engine/src/work.ts lines 117-151), the deterministic gate id inputs (decide whether declaredCommand participates in the id hash and record why), schemas/records/work-item.schema.json, and the runtime snapshot schema validation. No evaluation change yet. Migration: existing gates have both fields absent and evaluate exactly as before.
